aggregation: Geometric mean across four restarts within each realization, then across ten realizations
total_cost: Per-restart integer RTS99 multiplied by per-shot RU before aggregation
uncertainty: 25th and 75th percentiles across realization-level values; same capped-IQR convention as existing figures
additional_curve_depths: Include each method's own selected optimum; retain other old points in per_realization only
partial_groups: Never presented as complete ten-realization aggregates
